player_prompt.intro:
Yu em Pleya {player_id} pleyim gem bilong Pig Dice.

Rul na law: 
- Long taem bilong yu, yu ken '[roll]' o '[hold]'
- Rolim 2-6: Yu ken addim long taem bilong yu
- Rolim 1: Yu losim taem bilong yu na taem bilong yu i stap
- Holim: Yu addim taem bilong yu long skor bilong yu na taem bilong yu i stap
- Fastem winim {winning_score} poin

Long taem bilong yu, yu ken si skor i stap nau na taem bilong yu.
Yu tokim '[roll]' long rolim dai o '[hold]' long bankim poin bilong yu.

invalid_move.invalid_action: Foma bilong action i rong. Usim '[roll]' o '[hold]'.

actions.player_busted: Pleya {player_id} i go daun, losim {turn_total} poin!
actions.player_hold: Pleya {player_id} i holim na savim {turn_total} poin.
